title: Portable generator carbon-monoxide exclusion zone
summary: Prevent carbon-monoxide poisoning by keeping portable fuel-burning equipment outdoors and away from occupied openings.
content: Safe-use sequence: Never run a generator in a home, garage, shed, balcony enclosure, stairwell, or near doors, windows, or vents; use alarms and manufacturer instructions.

title: Safe night-lighting hierarchy
summary: Provide enough light for exits, stairs, toilets, medicines, and hazards without introducing flame, trip, glare, or battery-waste risks.
content: Safe-use sequence: Place low-power lights at route changes and task points, preserve one emergency light, and keep candles away from children, animals, fabrics, sleep, and unattended areas.
